core_obligations: The ringed diagram (proof lines 7506-7534): the underlying diagram of topoi is the one established in the proof of the modules-free comparison lemma (with h_n = a_{U_n}, h_{-1} = a_X); the structure sheaves are identified - O_{big,total} and O_{big} come from the structure sheaf of (Spaces/S)_fppf, and the continuous functor u behind h maps V/U_n to V/U_n, whence h_*O_{big,total} = O_U, making h a morphism of ringed simplicial sites and then of ringed topoi by the cited lemma; the components h_n agree with the a_{U_n}.

Commutativity (lines 7536-7541): the diagram commutes as a diagram of ringed topoi - the author omits this verification explicitly noting the diagram is already commutative as a diagram of topoi (see notes); all ringed structures were established in the preceding lines.
proof_roadmap: Reuse the proven topos-level comparison diagram and identify the four structure sheaves.
Promote h to a morphism of ringed simplicial sites via h_*O_{big,total} = O_U and apply the ringed-topoi lemma.
Note the ringed commutativity on top of the known topos commutativity.
